assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: Dermoid cysts are congenital cysts resulting from trapping of surface ectoderm along embryonic fusion lines.

assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: They most commonly present as asymptomatic congenital cystic swelling of the lateral one-third of the eyebrow.

assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: Microscopic features of dermoid cysts reveal dermal-based cysts lined by nonkeratinizing stratified squamous epithelium with a retained granular layer.

assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: Folliculosebaceous elements (eg, hair follicles, sebaceous glands), eccrine glands, apocrine glands, and arrector pili smooth muscle may be present

assertions.subject: Mature cystic teratomas
assertions.predicate: true ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal differentiation
assertions.quote: Lesions with true ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal differentiation are termed mature cystic teratomas
